metadata.dcterms:title: The Mukai pairing, I: a categorical approach
metadata.dcterms:creator: Willerton†, Andrei C˘ald˘araru∗and Simon
metadata.dcterms:abstract: We study the Hochschild homology of smooth spaces, emphasizing the importance of a pairing which generalizes Mukai’s pairing on the cohomology of K3 surfaces. We show that integral transforms between derived categories of spaces induce, functorially, linear maps on homol- ogy. Adjoint functors induce adjoint linear maps with respect to the Mukai pairing. We deﬁne a Chern character with values in Hochschild homology, and we discuss analogues of the Hirzebruch-Riemann-Roch theorem and the Cardy Condition from physics. This is done in the context of a 2-category which has spaces as its objects and integral kernels as its 1-morphisms.
